summary: This bill extends enhanced ACA premium tax credits through 2028 by amending the Internal Revenue Code to prolong increased assistance amounts and eligibility for households above 400% of the poverty line.

scores.thoughts: The bill extends enhanced premium tax credits under the ACA through 2028, directly increasing federal outlays on health insurance subsidies compared to allowing the enhancements to expire after 2025. This maintains higher levels of government spending on these programs.
The legislation extends tax credits that reduce tax liability for eligible individuals purchasing health insurance. This functions as a tax benefit/tax expenditure rather than an increase in taxes.

The core purpose is extending ACA premium tax credits that subsidize private marketplace insurance plans. This reinforces a market-based, subsidized private insurance system rather than moving toward a public or single-payer model.
